scripts.test:domain: PYTHONPATH=services/quant-domain/src uv run --project services/quant-domain --frozen python -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest discover -s services/quant-domain/test -p 'test_*.py' -v
scripts.test:golden: uv run --project services/quant-domain --frozen python scripts/verify-golden-backtest.py fixtures/backtests/m0-long-short-v1.json
scripts.test:m3-revisions: pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/contracts build && node --test packages/contracts/test/m3_revision_contracts.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @open-quant-studio/control-plane build && node --test apps/control-plane/test/m3-revision-tools.test.mjs && PYTHONPATH=services/quant-domain/src:services/quant-domain/test uv run --project services/quant-domain --frozen python -W error -m unittest test_m3_git_workspace test_m3_revisions test_m3_http
scripts.validate:m0: pnpm run check:bootstrap && pnpm run check:data-root && pnpm run test:contracts && pnpm run test:golden
